nodes.summary: With biallelic sites, the two emission probabilities at a site sum to `1` over the target allele, for each fixed panel column `col` (the emissions are conditional on the panel).
nodes.title: Biallelic emission probabilities sum to one

nodes.summary: The emission probability: `1 - ε` if the target allele equals the allele of the copied haplotype `k`, and the mismatch probability `ε` otherwise.
nodes.title: Li–Stephens emission probability

nodes.summary: The collapsed forward recursion computes the forward variables of the Li–Stephens HMM.
nodes.title: The collapsed forward recursion computes the forward variables

nodes.summary: The tabulated `O(K)` recursion computes the forward variables of the Li–Stephens HMM.
nodes.title: Tabulated recursion computes the Li–Stephens forward variables

nodes.summary: The `O(K)` forward variables, tabulated site by site: `O(t K)` operations in total.
nodes.title: Tabulated O(K) forward variables

nodes.summary: The forward variables of the collapsed recursion, as a function of site and state. This is the untabulated specification (it re-evaluates earlier sites inside each sum); `fastForwardTab` is the `O(t K)` implementation.
nodes.title: Forward variables of the collapsed recursion

nodes.summary: One tabulated `O(K)` step: the total of the previous table is computed once.
nodes.title: Tabulated O(K) forward step

nodes.summary: One step of the collapsed forward recursion on the previous site's forward variables `v`, at output state `k`: `e_k ((1 - ρ) v k + ρ (∑ j, v j) / K)`. This is the pointwise specification; each call evaluates the length-`K` sum, so use `fastStepTab` for the `O(K)` per-site step.
nodes.title: One step of the collapsed forward recursion

nodes.summary: The Li–Stephens copying model with `K` reference haplotypes, switch probability `ρ` and mismatch probability `ε`, as a hidden Markov model with a uniform initial copied haplotype.
nodes.title: The Li–Stephens copying model

nodes.summary: The initial law (uniform over the `K` haplotypes) sums to `1`.
nodes.title: Uniform initial law over haplotypes sums to one

nodes.summary: The likelihood of the target haplotype (given the panel) is the sum of the collapsed forward variables.
nodes.title: The likelihood of the target haplotype

nodes.summary: The tabulated `O(K)` recursion computes the likelihood of the target haplotype.
nodes.title: Tabulated recursion computes the haplotype likelihood

nodes.summary: The tabulated Li–Stephens likelihood in `O(t K)` operations.
nodes.title: The tabulated Li–Stephens likelihood

nodes.summary: The observation sequence for the reference panel `H` (haplotype `k` carries allele `H k t` at site `t`) and the target haplotype `x`.
nodes.title: Observation sequence of a reference panel and target haplotype

nodes.summary: The observation at a site: the column of reference alleles and the target allele.
nodes.title: Site observation in the Li–Stephens model

nodes.summary: The sum over predecessors collapses: `∑ j, v j * trans ρ j k = (1 - ρ) v k + ρ (∑ v) / K`.
nodes.title: Collapse of the sum over predecessor haplotypes

nodes.summary: Each transition row sums to `1` (when `K` is invertible in `R`, e.g. `K ≠ 0` over `ℝ`).
nodes.title: Li–Stephens transition rows sum to one

nodes.summary: The copying transition probability: switch with probability `ρ` to a uniformly random reference haplotype (possibly the same one), otherwise keep copying `k`: `(1 - ρ) [k = k'] + ρ / K`.
nodes.title: Li–Stephens copying transition probability

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
